scope: Keep exact full regression selection portable after expanded test filenames exceed the existing command-line guard.
riskAnalysis: CI stops before regression when enumerated arguments exceed24000characters. A fixed Node22 glob is permitted only for exact complete source-derived test membership; malformed, duplicate and oversized partial lists still deny.

threatModel.assets: Exact source-derived regression coverage, offline network preload, mandatory contract tests, bounded process concurrency and release identity.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Only validated canonical local test basenames may select files; spawnSync remains shell-free and fixed-pattern fallback cannot select custom paths.
threatModel.abuseCases: Oversized subset gains unrelated tests, arbitrary glob/path injection, missing or duplicate files, accidental inclusion of real Redis/helper scripts, or increased process concurrency.
threatModel.mitigations: Validate unique safe names first; require sorted equality with full actual .test.js set; one fixed literal pattern; keep fourworkers/offlinepreload and all existing source/release plan checks.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Malformed, duplicate, path-traversal and oversized fabricated test-name sets are rejected before spawning.
negativePaths.stale-state: Existing assertPlan checks exact source state before and after the complete suite; no stale coverage attestation is introduced.
negativePaths.concurrency: Fourworker limit unchanged; exact fixture verifies selected files run once.
negativePaths.cancellation: Not altered by fixed local test-file selection; existing required failure, cleanup and authorization regressions remain selected exactly once.

negativePaths.partial-execution: Not altered by fixed local test-file selection; existing required failure, cleanup and authorization regressions remain selected exactly once.

rollback: Revert runner/test changes and lock through authorized feature development if qualification fails; preserve failedCI and all original source/diagnostic evidence. No provider or audit data changes.

defects.rootCause: One full-suite filename argument per file eventually exceeded the portable process argument guard before tests could start.
defects.detectionGap: Portable runner test covered the earlier shorter complete suite and rejected synthetic oversized sets, without a bounded full-suite growth strategy.
defects.regression: Exact full filesystem-membership comparison and actual Node22 two-test glob fixture excluding .cjs/helper files; unsafe subsets still deny.
defects.historicalPrevention: Use fixed complete-suite discovery only after exact source-derived set verification; keep subset commands bounded and shell-free.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse the existing selection runner and Node22 test engine; no new orchestration, server or workflow framework.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No dependency install, new provider, service credentials or paid infrastructure.
proactiveReview.threats: A complete-suite fallback cannot accept user globs or arbitrary paths; source membership is verified before using the fixed literal.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Guard still rejects oversized subsets; failed tests and process errors continue to fail qualification.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Actual hosted argument-limit failure preserved; malformed/duplicate/unsafe/oversized fixtures and excluded-file subprocess exercised.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA and Engineering Auditor reviewed fallback and exclusion invariants; no material findings.
proactiveReview.recovery: Do not retry failed paid calls or modify timing tests; preserve source history and original CI failure.
